finalText:
Done — added a **4.2.0** section to `CHANGELOG.md`, dated 2026-08-21.

Out of ~380 commits and 127 merged PRs, only 11 were user-facing (1 feature, 9 fixes, 1 behavior change worth flagging as breaking). Everything else was dependency bumps, refactors, CI, and internal tests.

Worth double-checking yourself:
- **#4223** (`fix(auth): return 401 for an expired token instead of 403`) — I flagged this as Breaking, not just a fix, since any client branching on 403 for expired tokens will need an update. Confirm that's the call you want before this goes out.
- I used `merged-prs.tsv` as the source of truth for "what actually shipped." `commits.log` has several near-duplicate titles (e.g. "guard the null cursor in the paginator" shows up in queue, api, webhooks, and db) that never appear in the PR sheet — I treated those as superseded/unmerged attempts and left them out. Worth a sanity check if you know that log had extra real merges the sheet missed.
- I didn't include the perf commits (`batch the metric writes`, `avoid the extra clone in the mapper`, `skip the JSON round-trip`) — internal, no observable behavior change.
